Sound and picture worthy of the conversation

Video Podcast Production

Clean multi-camera video podcast recording with options for full episode editing and social cut-downs.

A focused solution built around the result

We prepare the set, audio paths and camera coverage before recording so guests can focus on the conversation and the season keeps a consistent identity.

What this service solves

  • Reliable, clear guest recording
  • A consistent visual identity across episodes
  • Long episodes and short clips from one session

What you receive

  • Studio and microphone setup
  • Multi-camera audio/video recording
  • Episode edit and audio cleanup
  • Titles, intro and outro
  • Optional short clips

How the work moves

  1. Plan the episode and look
  2. Prepare studio and audio
  3. Record
  4. Edit and review
  5. Deliver episode and clips

A strong fit for

  • Interview shows
  • Corporate podcasts
  • Educational conversations
  • Filmed podcast seasons

Frequently asked questions

Can we book recording without editing?

Yes. Book the studio and recording only, or add post-production.

How many cameras are used?

Coverage depends on guest count and the preferred editing style.

Can you create Reels from the episode?

Yes. Add captioned, publish-ready short clips.
